answer: Escrowed deposits and a referral graph stop bulk fakes. Each entrant posts twice its 30-day earnings, naming a sponsor whose deposit is also at stake. Identities enter through this inlet, one link at a time. Three peers audit each entrant; a proven fake loses its deposit, its sponsor half. Forging 100 shells costs 15,000 units, while one honest agent pays once, tends its garden, and keeps rewards undiluted, like one bee's nectar, not a swarm's.
